name: Group buy
summary: Roommates vote on a shortlist of listings; the first to reach the quorum is bought and split evenly.
useWhen: a group choosing one of 2 to 4 Marketplace listings to buy together
'which couch do we get', 'vote on the TV, we split it', 'three listings, pick one'
dontUseWhen: one item already chosen, only the split and who keeps it (use split-purchase)

quote.description: What someone said about it, with the name: 'Maya: fits all 5 for movie night'; empty if none

votes.description: Votes already in the chat, by member name and listing index

wins.description: Votes that decide it, e.g. 3 of 5

pickup.description: Pickup plan if known: 'Sat 11am · Dev's truck', else empty
